note: `count=` earns a fixture rather than riding along untested. Raised in review of quince#87: 'Only the newest comment is named when several land in one interval. Fine for waking; a count=N would let the woken session know whether it is reading one ruling or three.' Three comments land on a declared issue inside one interval — a real shape, since a watch re-armed after an outage diffs the whole gap at once, and the quince#62 thread took fifteen comments. Without the count the session reads one event, acts on the newest, and is confident about a thread it has only partly seen: the same class of wrong as `updated` naming a bystander. `at=` and `actor=` still describe the NEWEST comment, which is what a woken session needs to find its place; the count is what tells it to keep reading upward.
